profil.prompt: Top-down close-up of an aged dark-brown leather notebook lying on a weathered walnut wooden table. Debossed into the center of the leather cover is a simple emblem: a sharp pointed rocky peak with a tiny ruined castle tower on its summit and three gentle wave lines beneath it; the emblem's lines are softly gilded in worn gold leaf. The emblem is perfectly centered and fills about half of the frame. A few hazelnuts and one hazelnut leaf rest near the bottom corners. Soft warm window light from the upper left, crisp leather grain detail, everything important stays inside a centered circle.

oc-kaleler.prompt: Close-up of a weathered ancient fortress stone wall with a narrow arrow slit in the center, moss in the joints, warm late-afternoon side light, dark warm surroundings, subject centered.

oc-yapilar.prompt: Close-up of a carved stone arched doorway of a 19th-century cut-stone church in a Black Sea coastal town, warm light on the stone, dark shadowed interior, subject centered.

oc-koy-adlari.prompt: An old weathered wooden village signpost with two blank arrow-shaped boards (no writing at all) standing at the edge of a misty hazelnut orchard path, soft morning light, subject centered.

oc-tiyatro.prompt: Deep red velvet theatre curtain slightly parted in the center, a warm golden spotlight glow behind the gap, dust floating in the light beam, dark edges.

oc-kaynakca.prompt: A small stack of old leather-bound books with an aged handwritten paper document and a brass magnifying glass on top, writing not legible, warm lamp light, dark wooden desk, subject centered.

bg-1.prompt: The same aged dark-brown leather notebook, now open on a walnut desk beside a window; through the window a hazy view of a Black Sea coastal town under a green hill at dusk; warm lamp light on the pages; the upper third of the frame is calm and dark, empty space for a title.

bg-2.prompt: Flat lay of a dark walnut desk surface in soft warm light, an old fountain pen and a few hazelnuts along the bottom edge, the rest of the frame is calm dark wood with generous empty space.

bg-3.prompt: Dusk photograph of a sharp pointed rocky peak crowned with ancient stone fortress ruins and a thin column of smoke, rising above a lush green river valley in the eastern Black Sea mountains, hazelnut orchards on the slopes; the dark sky in the upper part and the shadowed valley at the bottom leave room for text.
